system.description: Salvage is the art of collecting useful items from things you have deconstructed or failed to properly craft. Salvaging usually takes 1 hour to accomplish. At the end of that time, make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you recover half of the important raw materials.

upgrades.description: On Success, you recover all of the important raw materials.
On a crafting Standard Fail or Near Miss, roll your crafting Check again with Advantage, with an additional 15-minute time expenditure.

system.limitations: Salvage cannot be used with explosive devices.
